Session date: 7:59 pm on 4 November, 2023
[D27:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey, had a great weekend! My girlfriend and I went on a bike ride and stumbled upon a cool park outside of town. It was awesome to get away from the city and be surrounded by nature.
[D27:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two people riding bikes on a paved path
[D27:2] Audrey: That's cool! I love checking out new parks with my four pups. Last weekend was so fun - our dogs were able to run around and get some fresh air. On top of that, I recently joined a dog owners group to learn how to better take care of them.
[D27:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people and dogs in a park
[D27:3] Andrew: That sounds great! Your four pups must have a lot of fun. How often do you hang out with the dog owners group?
[D27:4] Audrey: Yeah, they're having a lot of fun. I try to meet up with other dog owners once a week for tips from other parents and so they can all play together. How about you? Have you ever thought about joining one?
[D27:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people and dogs in a park
[D27:5] Andrew: That looks fun! Seeing those adorable pups made me think about getting another dog, but I'm still not sure. Having two dogs is already a lot to take care of. Do you have any tips on being a multi-dog pet owner?
[D27:6] Audrey: Maybe you want to take care of Toby and Buddy first. Having them happy and healthy would be a good first step before going all in for more dogs.
[D27:7] Andrew: Thanks, I think that's what I need to hear. I'll take good care of my dogs first.
[D27:8] Audrey: That's great! Let me know if you need any help, I'm here for you! See how happy they are? You don't need more dogs to make them happy! :)
[D27:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs playing with a frisbee in a park
[D27:9] Andrew: Thanks Audrey! That's so nice of you. I think I've managed to make it work with dogs while still living in the city.
[D27:10] Audrey: Yeah I feel you. Taking care of a pup in the city is tough but doable with the right approach. Keeping them active is key. Here's a pic of how I entertain them in my house with toys and games.
[D27:10] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a basket full of stuffed animals on a wooden floor
[D27:11] Andrew: Wow, it's great to know there are ways to keep them active in the city. I'll keep that in mind. Thank you so much!
[D27:12] Audrey: You got it! There are lots of ways to keep them happy in the city. Make sure to socialize and exercise them daily. Get creative and add some mental stimulation too. Here's a pic of them playing fetch in the park - they love it!
[D27:12] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog running with a tennis ball in its mouth
[D27:13] Andrew: That's so cute! What sort of activities do you do to stay mentally stimulated?
[D27:14] Audrey: We give them lots of activities to keep them busy - puzzles, training, hide-and-seek - they love it all!
[D27:14] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog playing with a frisbee in a room
[D27:15] Andrew: Cool ideas! I think I'll give those activities a try with my pups. Thanks!
[D27:16] Audrey: No problem, glad I could help. Let me know how it goes.
[D27:17] Andrew: Your advice and support really mean a lot to me! Thank you so much!
[D27:18] Audrey: That's what friends are for - supporting each other. Your friendship means a lot to me. :)

Session date: 11:27 am on 2 June, 2023
[D7:6] Andrew: Wow, incredible sunset and the scenery! Must have been magical. Thanks for sharing!

Session date: 5:23 pm on 13 June, 2023
[D8:1] Andrew: Hey! Long time no chat. Last Sunday was awesome - my friends and I took a rock climbing class and I made it to the top! It was a fantastic experience and now I'm hooked. Think I'm going to try to do more outdoor activities like this every week!
[D8:2] Audrey: That's awesome! Glad you had such a rad experience rock climbing. I'm always in awe of people who can climb mountains. Got any pics or videos from your climb? Would love to see the view from the top!
[D8:3] Andrew: Rock climbing was awesome! It was a challenge, but so satisfying. The view was stunning, and I was really proud of myself. Nature sure is amazing!

[Shares a photo of the view from the top of the rock climbed during the rock climbing class]
[D8:3] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man climbing on a rock face to face
[D8:4] Audrey: Wow that view is stunning! Congrats on reaching the top, that must have been a huge accomplishment. Nature really reminds us how tiny we are in comparison, yeah? Was it challenging getting there?
[D8:5] Andrew: Thanks! It was a big achievement for me. The climb was tricky, especially since I'm still a newbie. But I made it with the support and cheer from my friends.
[D8:6] Audrey: Nice! Having a solid support group really helps when things get tough. You're lucky to have such great friends! Does this adventure encourage you to try more outdoor activities?
[D8:7] Andrew: Yeah, rock climbing was awesome - I felt so accomplished reaching the top. It has definitely encouraged me to try more outdoor activities like kayaking and maybe bungee jumping? Nature always pushes me out of my comfort zone!
[D8:8] Audrey: Wow going all in huh? Have fun with kayaking and bungee jumping! Last week, I found a great spot for my dogs' walk. It's a small park with a trail surrounded by trees. It's so nice and I think my dogs like it too. Would you like to come along?
[D8:9] Andrew: Sounds great, Audrey! I'd love to join you and your pups for a walk. Being in nature with dogs sounds like a great time!
[D8:10] Audrey: Awesome! Can't wait to have fun with everyone. My dogs love meeting new people. 
[D8:11] Andrew: Sames, can't wait to meet them and take a stroll in the park.
[D8:12] Audrey: This was taken during the walk in the park. See how happy they are?
[D8:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D8:13] Andrew: Aww, they look like they're really enjoying themselves. How long do you usually walk them for?
[D8:14] Audrey: Varies depending on the day, but usually for about an hour. We let them explore at their own pace.
[D8:15] Andrew: Cool, that's a good amount of time for them to have a nice stroll and take a look around.
[D8:16] Audrey: They need exercise and to explore - they always go home with a smile and tired.
[D8:17] Andrew: Nice! Letting them explore and have fun is important. I'm sure they must be loving it!
[D8:18] Audrey: Yeah, they love it! It's their favorite part of the day! Their faces blightens up as soon as I get ready for a walk.
[D8:19] Andrew: Of course! Nature always makes us and our pets so happy.
[D8:20] Audrey: Definitely! Dogs and nature bring me so much joy and peace.
[D8:21] Andrew: Yeah, I agree, it's really nice.
[D8:22] Audrey: So check out how happy they are in this meadow! They make me so happy.
[D8:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs playing with a frisbee in a field
[D8:23] Andrew: Aww so cute. Your dogs look so content in that picture. The meadow looks so nice. It's great that nature brings your pets joy!
[D8:24] Audrey: Being outdoors with them puts me in my happy place. It's peaceful and inspiring.
[D8:25] Andrew: Glad you found something that puts you in your happy place. It's true, being outdoors has a way of inspiring and calming us.
[D8:26] Audrey: Yeah! It's incredible how nature can make us think differently.
[D8:27] Andrew: Agreed! It's great for refreshing the mind and giving a different outlook. Whenever I'm in need of a reset, I turn to nature.
[D8:28] Audrey: Nature has a way of making us feel alive and centered. Let's appreciate what it gives us.
Session date: 1:51 pm on 26 June, 2023

[D9:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two dogs sitting on the grass in front of a house
[D9:2] Andrew: That's awesome! Your new place looks great. Your fur babies must be thrilled with the bigger backyard. I'm sure they're having a blast running around. How are they settling in?

[D9:5] Audrey: Yep, I set up a doggy play area in the backyard with agility stuff and toys - they're loving it!
[D9:6] Andrew: Wow you really went in huh!?  Now they have a great place to play and explore, that's awesome! Take a look at this place I'm at.
[D9:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of dogs playing with a ball in a large indoor area
[D9:7] Audrey: That looks fun! Where are you at? I would love to take the dogs there sometime soon.

[D9:18] Andrew: Last Friday, I hiked with some friends. The weather was great and it felt so good to be outdoors. We got some awesome pictures too.

passages.title: LoCoMo conv-44 history chunk 1
passages.text:
Session date: 1:10 pm on 27 March, 2023
[D1:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Good to see ya! What's been up since we last talked?
[D1:2] Andrew: Hey Audrey! So, I started a new job as a Financial Analyst last week - it's been quite a change from my previous job. How about you? Anything interesting happening?
[D1:3] Audrey: Congrats on the new job! So I got these new collars and tags for my dogs - so cute!
[D1:4] Andrew: Thanks! That sounds cute. Can I see a picture?
[D1:5] Audrey: Sure! See them with their new collars, cute right?
[D1:5] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two dogs are standing in the grass with their mouths open
[D1:6] Andrew: Cute little guys! What are their names and how long have you had them?
[D1:7] Audrey: I've had them for 3 years! Their names are Pepper, Precious and Panda. I can't live without my little ones!
[D1:8] Andrew: That's awesome! Have you always wanted a dog, even with living in the city? Can they still go on adventures?
[D1:9] Audrey: Absolutely! They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often.
[D1:10] Andrew: Wow, sounds like they make life so awesome! Kinda jealous of all those fun outings with them.
[D1:11] Audrey: They really do! It's great how much happiness they bring. Do you have any pets?
[D1:12] Andrew: No, no pets right now. But I do love animals.
[D1:13] Audrey: That's great to hear! Animals are truly amazing. Do you have a favorite animal?
[D1:14] Andrew: I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing.
[D1:15] Audrey: Yeah, birds are amazing! I can imagine it feels incredible to soar and see the world from up high. Do you have a favorite type of bird?
[D1:16] Andrew: Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful!
[D1:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two birds flying in the sky with a sun shining behind them
[D1:17] Audrey: Yeah they're beautiful. Do you go bird-watching? It must be awesome to see them up close.
[D1:18] Andrew: Haven't specifically gone out for bird-watching, but I do spot them when I hike.
[D1:19] Audrey: Nice, spotting pretty birds while hiking must be great. Do you have any favorite hiking spots?
[D1:20] Andrew: Fox Hollow is a great trail to hike on weekends; the views are awesome!
[D1:21] Audrey: Cool, gonna give it a try. Thanks for the suggestion!
[D1:22] Andrew: No problem! Let me know how you like it. Have fun hiking!
[D1:23] Audrey: Thanks! I'll let you know. Have a good one!
[D1:24] Andrew: Take care and have a good one! See ya!
Session date: 2:42 pm on 2 April, 2023
[D2:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew, I got a surprise for you! We adopted another puppy called Pixie. She's SO cute! Isn't she just the cutest?
[D2:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a small white dog sitting on a carpet
[D2:2] Andrew: That's awesome! Pixie is so cute! Did you ever check out that hiking spot we talked about last time?
[D2:3] Audrey: Thanks! I know right? She's so cute! Pixie's been keeping us busy, so I haven't had a chance to check out that hiking spot yet.
[D2:4] Andrew: Yeah, I get it. A puppy really takes some work. Has she settled in okay? Is she getting along with the other pups?
[D2:5] Audrey: Pixie's fitting in great! It took her a few days to get used to the other dogs, but now they're awesome friends. They love playing and exploring the house - so cute!

[D2:5] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog playing with a group of other dogs
[D2:6] Andrew: That's awesome! Is Pepper adjusting well to her?
[D2:7] Audrey: Pepper took a bit to get used to her, but now they're always together!
[D2:7] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two dogs standing in the grass near a fence
[D2:8] Andrew: That's great to hear! I'm considering getting a dog too, but it can be challenging finding a dog-friendly place in the city. Do you have any tips on finding such a place?
[D2:9] Audrey: We used websites that helped us find a place that allowed dogs. They had filters that made it super easy. Found a perfect spot thanks to them!
[D2:9] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog sitting in a field of flowers
[D2:10] Andrew: Wow, that's so cool! I'll give those websites a try, thanks for the info!
[D2:11] Audrey: You got it! I hope you find a great spot soon!
[D2:12] Andrew: Thanks! Fingers crossed for the apartment and that furry friend.
[D2:13] Audrey: I'm keeping my fingers crossed for you to find a great furry friend and an apartment.
[D2:14] Andrew: Hope I find one soon. Can't wait!
[D2:15] Audrey: You'll love them! They're great for cuddles and companionship.
[D2:16] Andrew: It'd be so great to have a furry buddy to cuddle and hang with. Here's a photo of my family's dog on a couch. 
[D2:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog sitting on a couch in a living room
[D2:17] Audrey: Our furry friends make great cuddle buddies. Here's one of them enjoying some lazy couch time!
[D2:17] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog laying on a couch with a pillow
[D2:18] Andrew: That pic is so cute! It would be fun to hang out with a dog, cuddling away. Got me thinking of my old hiking pics and how much I miss exploring nature trails with my family's dog. Ah, the peaceful moments out in nature!
[D2:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man walking a dog on a trail
[D2:19] Audrey:  Taking them on hikes must be awesome! That makes me want to hike with my dogs.
[D2:20] Andrew: Hiking with a dog is way fun, it's a great way to bond and create memories together.
[D2:20] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man sitting on a rock with a dog
[D2:21] Audrey: Yeah! Exploring nature with them and making memories is awesome!
[D2:22] Andrew: Definitely! I miss those moments. I need to find a dog-friendly spot soon so I can get exploring again!
[D2:23] Audrey: Yep! I hope you find the perfect dog-friendly spot soon so you can make new memories with them.
[D2:24] Andrew: Thanks! I'll keep looking until I find it. Super excited for what's next!
[D2:25] Audrey: So excited for you! I can't wait to see where you and your furry friend decide to hang out. All the best!
[D2:26] Andrew: I'll keep you posted. Ttyl, Bye!
Session date: 4:19 pm on 16 April, 2023
[D3:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey! What's up? Missed chatting with ya! Check it out, my girl & I tried out that new cafe scene in the city last weekend! Super fun but kinda sad not being out in nature - that's when I feel like I'm really thriving. Oh man, I miss the peacefulness of being out on a hike.
[D3:2] Audrey: Hey Andrew! That cafe sounds pretty awesome, glad you enjoyed it. Yeah, I know what you mean. That feeling of being out in nature, surrounded by beauty and peace, is unbeatable, compared to being surrounded by concrete jungles. 
[D3:3] Andrew: Yeah, being out in the nature really has a way of taking my breath away. It's like a home for my soul! I feel connected when I'm there.
[D3:4] Audrey: I totally get it. Nature has a way of bringing us back down to earth and reminding us that we're part of something bigger. It's amazing.
[D3:5] Andrew: Yeah, it's like hitting the reset button when life gets too chaotic. Nature has a way of being really soothing.
[D3:6] Audrey: Definitely! For me, taking my dogs for a walk in the park helps me find my center and recharges me.

passages.title: LoCoMo conv-44 history chunk 2
passages.text:
Session date: 4:19 pm on 16 April, 2023

[D3:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a muffin pan filled with blueberries and muffins
[D3:19] Andrew: That looks delicious! A pastry party sounds awesome, count me in!

[D3:21] Andrew: Definitely! They'll have a great time at the party! Can't wait for the party!

[D3:24] Audrey: Yay! This'll be awesome! Seeing them all together, having fun and enjoying treats is the best. I can't imagine life without them, they bring so much joy.
[D3:24] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog running with three other dogs in the background

[D3:28] Audrey: Thanks! I got it a while ago. It represents my love for my pups and nature's beauty.
[D3:28] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a woman walking with her dogs in the woods
[D3:29] Andrew: Aww, that's cute! What made you getting the tattoo?
[D3:30] Audrey: I've always had a strong bond with them – they make me so happy, and I just want to see their happy faceseven when thry're not with me.
[D3:31] Andrew: That's awesome, I'm glad they bring so much joy into your life.
Session date: 5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023
[D4:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last week I finally went on a hike and had this amazing experience with a hummingbird. It was so cool watching it dart around with its wings! Nature is so beautiful.
[D4:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a hummingbird sitting on a branch with its wings spread
[D4:2] Andrew: Hey Audrey! Glad to hear from you. That hummingbird was awesome! Nature's the best. Remember I was feeling down because I couldn't get out more? Well, good news - I found a new open space to hike nearby - feels so refreshing!
[D4:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a view of a lake and mountains at sunset
[D4:3] Audrey: That looks great! How often are you able to go hiking now?
[D4:4] Andrew: So I usually try to escape the city at least once a weekend - it's my much-needed break!
[D4:5] Audrey: Nice! I Bet it's great to get away like that.
[D4:6] Andrew: Yep! Nature is so therapeutic for me. It's hard to put into words how great it feels to be surrounded by greenery or standing on top of a mountain breathing in the fresh air. So peaceful and invigorating.


[D4:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a mountain range with a sunset in the background
[D4:7] Audrey: Wow, that view looks great! It really captures that calming and peaceful feeling. It must be really satisfying to capture that tranquility.
[D4:8] Andrew: Yeah! I try to capture those special moments and share that feeling with others.
[D4:9] Audrey: That's really cool! Spreading that peaceful feeling to others is such a great way to bring happiness and motivation.
[D4:10] Andrew: I agree! It brings me joy to spread that feeling and motivate people to find their own peace - it's like a ripple effect, spreading positivity.
[D4:11] Audrey: Absolutely. Not only the receiving end feels great, the person spreading it will feel great as well!
[D4:12] Andrew: Yeah, it's crazy how that can bring such great joy and calm to people.
[D4:13] Audrey: Yeah, by sharing something can make a big difference to others.
[D4:14] Andrew: Yup! We don't realize it, but even the littlest gestures can have a big effect. Spreading good vibes and joy, that's the goal right? So what's up? Anything new or fun going on?
[D4:15] Audrey: Not much has changed since we last talked. I'm busy taking care of my pets and spending time with them. It's really fulfilling.
[D4:15] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a group of dogs sitting on top of a lush green field
[D4:16] Andrew: I bet it's awesome hanging out with them - do your dogs enjoy going on hikes?
[D4:17] Audrey: My dogs go nuts when we go on hikes! They love exploring new scents and being in nature - it's their happy place. I can tell by their wagging tails and expressions how much they love it. It's so great to see them having so much fun!
[D4:17] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog running in a field with other dogs
[D4:18] Andrew: Wow, that's great! I was wondering if you have any tips or tricks for keeping dogs safe when they're out and about?
[D4:19] Audrey: Definitely! Safety is super important for me. I even got them something special. They sure look funny, but it works!
[D4:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog with a leash and shoes on
[D4:20] Andrew: Awesome to see that you take such good care of your dogs! What else do you do when you walk them?
[D4:21] Audrey: When I take them out, we usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee. They love chasing it! We also meet other dog owners in the park and have a doggie playdate. It's a great way for me to chat with people and for them to make new friends.
[D4:21] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog catching a frisbee in a field
[D4:22] Andrew: Wow, looks like fun! They sure look excited about playing fetch!
[D4:23] Audrey: They absolutely adore it! They have tons of energy and love meeting new pals at playdates. Plus, they always get excited when I bring those out.
[D4:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog wearing a party hat sitting on a couch
[D4:24] Andrew: Aww, that's so cute! Do they enjoy wearing the party hats? And where did you find their playdates?

[D24:7] Audrey: That's perfect! Sounds like Buddy really is your sidekick. Do you have any favorite activities you two like to do together?

Session date: 10:14 am on 24 October, 2023
[D25:1] Andrew: Hi Audrey! How have you been lately? My girlfriend and I went to this awesome wine tasting last weekend. It was great! We tried so many unique wines and learned a lot. I was surprised at how much I enjoyed it. A reminder to step out of the comfort zone!
[D25:2] Audrey: Hey! Ha, glad you had fun at the wine tasting. Yeah, trying new things can be cool. By the way, I had an unexpected adventure last week. I had an accident while playing with my pups at the park. Taking care of them with one arm has been tricky but we're managing. What's been up with you? Any new interests?
[D25:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person with a cast on their arm and arm in a cast
[D25:3] Andrew: Ouch! Are you feeling better? Sending healing vibes to you and your pups. So I recently tried out this new spot in town that serves sushi and it was great. Do you have anything that you've been wanting to try lately?
[D25:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a plate of sushi and vegetables on a table
[D25:4] Audrey: Thanks! Appreciate it, feeling better each day. And wow that Sushi looks phenomenal. I know what to get for dinner tonight.
[D25:5] Andrew: Taking it one day at a time is the way to go. A while ago I've been curious about trying sushi. Never done it before, but always hear it's good. Now I understand what the hype is. Have you ever tried it?
[D25:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a tray of sushi with a variety of toppings
[D25:6] Audrey: Yess! Sushi is delicious! I love them! There are so many types and flavors to try. Definitely give it a go and try different things! Don't limit yourself in your comofort zone!
[D25:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a plate of sushi and vegetables on a table
[D25:7] Andrew: Thanks for the encouragement! I'm looking forward to trying more soon. Do you have any tips for someone who's new to sushi?
[D25:8] Audrey: Definitely try a California or salmon roll first when trying sushi - they're easier. Mix it up with different sauces and dips too - it makes it more tasty. Enjoy and let me know how it goes!
[D25:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a long plate of sushi with sauce on it
[D25:9] Andrew: Thanks for the tips! Gonna go with a California or salmon roll and try out some sauces. I'll let you know how it goes.
[D25:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person eating sushi on a wooden board
[D25:10] Audrey: Glad to help! Can't wait to hear about your sushi adventure. Take your time and have fun!
[D25:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a plate of sushi with avocado and shrimp
[D25:11] Andrew: I'm really excited to try different sushi. It's going to be a great time!
[D25:12] Audrey: Have fun! You'll definitely need some time to get used to, but once you start I believe you'll love it! Take some pics and show me what you enjoy.
[D25:13] Andrew: Haha, I'll make sure to take some photos and show you my sushi adventure.
[D25:14] Audrey: Enjoy! Now I'm gonna order some sushi for tonight. Thanks!
[D25:15] Andrew: Haha! You're welcomoe! Have a good one!
[D25:16] Audrey: Take care and have a good one!
Session date: 2:36 pm on 28 October, 2023
[D26:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew, I wanted to let you know about something going on with my dogs. I noticed they weren't acting normally, so I made an appointment with an animal behaviorist last Wed. It's been a bit hectic but I'm hopeful it'll help me better understand them.
[D26:2] Andrew: Oh no! Sorry to hear that your dogs haven't been themselves. Are they doing ok? How did the appointment with the animal behaviorist go? Did you receive any helpful advice or insights?
[D26:3] Audrey: The appointment went okay. It was hectic at first, but the behaviorist checked them out and asked some questions. I got some tips to try and help with their problems now.
[D26:4] Andrew: So what tips did you get? What will you be doing to help with the problems?
[D26:5] Audrey: The behaviorist gave me tips on how to handle it and suggested some changes in their routine. I'm using positive reinforcement techniques and it's still a work in progress, but I'm hopeful it'll help.
[D26:6] Andrew: I'm glad your pups are still good with positive reinforcement! How are they doing with the new approach tho?
[D26:7] Audrey: So far they seem to be responding well to it! It won't be fixed immediately but I'm seeing some progress. Here's hoping it keeps going.
[D26:8] Andrew: That's good to hear! Keep up the good work!
[D26:9] Audrey: Thanks! Your words of encouragement really mean a lot. It's tough, but I'm devoted to keeping them healthy and happy - they mean everything to me.
[D26:10] Andrew: You're doing a great job! They're lucky to have you.
[D26:11] Audrey: Thanks! They're really special to me and I want the best for them. Here's a pic of them having a blast last summer, so happy! I'm looking forward the day they are back to normal.
[D26:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D26:12] Andrew: Aww, they're having such a blast! What kind are they? I'm wishing you and your pups the best. 
[D26:13] Audrey: Thanks! They're all mutts, but Pepper and Panda are Lab mixes, and Precious and Pixie are Chihuahua mixes. I really need that. I can't wait the day they're all back to normal.
[D26:14] Andrew: Sending prayers and wishes. Here's a pic I took at a national park I went a while ago.
[D26:14] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man hiking up a mountain with a backpack
